0022600102.text: The Lakers (1-0, 1-0 at home) host the LA Clippers (1-0), who sit first in the Pacific while the Lakers are second in the division and fourth in the West. The Lakers are missing Adou Thiero (out, knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (out, oblique strain), and Jake LaRavia is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a gametime decision, while the Clippers are without Bradley Beal (out, knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (out, shoulder surgery), Max Strus (out, foot plantar fasciitis), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (out, foot surgery). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the Lakers winning the most recent meeting 125-122 in Los Angeles on February 20, 2026.
